subject: SOC 2 status & next steps — FinCo compliance discovery
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@finco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — SOC 2 status & questionnaire (FinCo)
Attachments: Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx

Hi Emily — great speaking earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Call highlights:
- FinCo is evaluating Redwood for high-throughput inference for transaction scoring across US customers.
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 status, data residency (EU customers soon), HIPAA applicability for an upcoming healthcare pilot, and vendor questionnaire turnaround.
- Security owner at FinCo: Carl Peters (cc'd).

What I heard (please correct if I missed anything):
1) SOC 2: FinCo requires confirmation of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II status (scope: security + availability). You mentioned this is a gating item for procurement.
2) GDPR / data residency: Some EU accounts will need data region controls — interested in our VPC/private deployment options.
3) HIPAA: Pilot may require a BAA depending on PHI; you flagged this as a decision for legal.
4) Vendor questionnaire: FinCo prefers an Excel-based questionnaire and a named security contact to complete it.

Proposed next steps:
- I attach our standard Vendor Security Questionnaire (Excel) — if you can share Carl's preferred contact, we'll pre-populate common answers to speed review.
- I'll attach our SOC 2 snapshot and point-of-contact for audit verification (we can provide SOC attestation and our auditor contact).
- Schedule a 30-min follow-up with Carl + one of our SEs to walk through Qs and any architecture constraints.

Timelines you mentioned: procurement review in ~3 weeks. If we can get the questionnaire back in 5 business days, that should keep things on track.

Questions for you now:
- Do you need a formal BAA for the pilot or is this exploratory?
- Any specific FedRAMP/industry certifications that matter for FinCo right now?

Thanks — I'll hold the follow-up scheduling until I hear Carl's availability.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Emily Shaw <emily.shaw@finco.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — SOC 2 status & questionnaire (FinCo)

Thanks, Sean — and thanks for the recap. A few updates from our side: 

SOC 2: We need SOC 2 Type II for security + availability. If you can provide the attestation and a short summary of scope (systems included, data types), that will speed legal review.

HIPAA: The pilot may include limited PHI. At minimum we need to know if Redwood will sign a BAA; legal will confirm but please flag if this is a blocker.

ISO 27001 / Roadmap: We are starting to scope vendors for ISO later this year — not required now but nice-to-have. For now SOC 2 is primary.

Vendor questionnaire: Carl will take this. Carl, can you confirm who on your team will own completion and a target date?

Proposed timeline: questionnaire back by Fri, 19 Sep if possible. Procurement will do an initial pass the week of Sep 21.

Carl — happy to jump on a 30-min call Wed or Thu this week afternoon PST — what works?

Best,
Emily Shaw
Head of Procurement | FinCo
emily.shaw@finco.com
From: Carl Peters <c.peters@finco.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — SOC 2 status & questionnaire (FinCo)

Emily — I'll own the questionnaire. I work on vendor security assessments (security@finco.com). 

Quick notes:
- SOC 2: If you can provide the attestation PDF and a short controls mapping (which systems/services are in-scope), that will suffice for our procurement gate.
- HIPAA / BAA: Legal has asked whether Redwood has signed BAAs before — if yes, please share a sample or note exceptions. If not, indicate willingness to discuss.
- ISO / FedRAMP: Not required now, but please include any roadmap notes (e.g., planned ISO 27001 certification in 2027, FedRAMP not applicable).

I'll aim to return the completed questionnaire by Fri 19 Sep. If your SE can pre-fill obvious answers (encryption in transit/at rest, MFA, incident response RTOs), that will save time.

Thanks,
Carl Peters

Hi all — quick follow from the SE side. Thanks for the clarity, Carl. A few clarifications and offers to help: 

1) We'll pre-populate the questionnaire with standard answers where appropriate (we'll mark those as "SE-provided"). Expect sections on encryption (TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest for managed storage), IAM (SAML + SCIM available for dedicated customers), logging & monitoring (centralized logs with 90-day retention by default, longer retention options available), and SOC 2 controls references.
2) SOC 2 attestation: we'll provide the pdf attestation and a one-page scope summary (list of services & environments included).
3) HIPAA / BAA: Redwood is open to executing BAAs for customers with covered use cases; we can route legal contact once the need is confirmed.
4) ISO / FedRAMP roadmap: Current plan is to pursue ISO 27001 in H2 2027; FedRAMP not on immediate roadmap. We'll include that note in the questionnaire.

Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync Thu 16 Sep 2026 11:00am PST (30 mins) to walk through any questionnaire items and pre-filled answers. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and attach the pre-filled draft.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
